description: The figure presents three pie charts illustrating human pairwise comparison results across three datasets—Truthful Review, Funny Reddit, and Unhealthy Comments—each showing preferences for hypotheses with demonstrations (W/ Demos), without demonstrations (W/o Demos), and cases where it was hard to tell the difference (Hard to Tell). In the Truthful Review dataset, the W/o Demos category accounts for 43.0% of responses (light gray), W/ Demos accounts for 34.1% (light green), and Hard to Tell accounts for 22.9% (blue). In the Funny Reddit dataset, W/o Demos accounts for 41.5% (light gray), W/ Demos accounts for 37.1% (light green), and Hard to Tell accounts for 21.5% (blue). In the Unhealthy Comments dataset, W/o Demos accounts for 37.8% (light gray), W/ Demos accounts for 34.8% (light green), and Hard to Tell accounts for 27.4% (blue). The legend at the top indicates the color coding for each category, and each slice within the pie charts is labeled with its corresponding percentage. The charts are arranged in a triangular layout, with Truthful Review at the top and the other two below, and the proportions of the slices vary across the datasets.
